title: 蜘蛛の糸 (Kumo no Ito / The Spider's Thread)
description: A criminal named Kandata is in Hell. The Buddha, looking down from Heaven, notices Kandata once spared a spider's life. He lowers a silver thread down to him as a chance at salvation — but Kandata's greed ultimately seals his fate. One of the most well-known pieces of modern Japanese literature, commonly read by Japanese middle school students.
author: 芥川龍之介
